headline: AMPERS&ONE hit career-high first-week sales
sub: 1st full album 'PATHFINDER' sells 181,698 copies in week one
source: Source: Hanteo Chart via Korean media
caption:
AMPERS&ONE just set a new personal record!

Their first full-length album 'PATHFINDER', released Nov 17, sold 181,698 copies in its first week according to Hanteo Chart — the group's best first-week figure yet. The 'King's Way' MV also reached No. 10 on YouTube Korea's daily popular music video chart, and the group continues promotions on music shows.

📌 Source: Hanteo Chart, via Korean media (Joy News 24, Dailian)
